notes: The MKR WiFi 1010 is not in the catalogue (only MKR 1000 and others), so a new type was created using the pin labels shown in the circuit image.

Breadboard rows: the image's upper half is labelled j-f (top to bottom); mapped to catalogue bank 't' rows a-e (j->a, i->b, h->c, g->d, f->e). The resistor and LED-cathode wire sit in image row h (-> row c); the LED legs are in row i (-> row b) of columns 6 and 8.
LED anode is the bent (longer) leg in column 6, joined to the resistor; the cathode in column 8 goes to GND via the black wire. This agrees with the schematic (pin 2 -> resistor -> LED -> GND).
Resistor spans columns 3 and 6; the green wire from pin 2 enters column 3 in the same strip as the resistor's left leg (placed at row d).
The micro USB cable is listed in the manual but not drawn in the circuit image, so it is not included as a node. The code reads A1, but nothing is wired to it.
The 220 ohm value comes from the schematic and the parts list.
